notes.text:
This update for tiff fixes the following issues

Security issues:

- CVE-2025-8851: libtiff: LibTIFF Stack-based buffer overflow (bsc#1248278).
- CVE-2026-4775: signed integer overflow in the `putcontig8bitYCbCr44tile` function (bsc#1260411).

Non security issue:

- QGIS can't export with GDAL- LERC codec, LERC library not found anywhere in the system (bsc#1257123).
